description: Provisional candidate Bayesian node table for differential diagnosis chest-pain triage.

nodes.name: pain_character
nodes.question_text: How would you characterize your chest pain (e.g. heavy pressure, burning, sharp knife-like, cramp)?

nodes.name: pain_radiation
nodes.question_text: Does your chest pain radiate anywhere (such as your arm, shoulder, back, neck, or jaw)?

nodes.name: sweating
nodes.question_text: Have you had significantly increased sweating (diaphoresis)?

nodes.name: shortness_of_breath
nodes.question_text: Are you experiencing shortness of breath or difficulty breathing?

nodes.name: racing_heart
nodes.question_text: Do you feel your heart is beating fast (racing), irregularly, or having palpitations?

nodes.name: worse_after_eating
nodes.question_text: Do your symptoms get worse after eating or after meals?

nodes.name: burning_sensation
nodes.question_text: Do you feel a burning sensation in your chest, stomach, or throat (heartburn/acid)?

nodes.name: worse_lying_down
nodes.question_text: Are your symptoms worse when lying down flat and alleviated by sitting up or leaning forward?

nodes.name: pleuritic_pain
nodes.question_text: Does your chest pain increase when taking a deep breath in or coughing?

nodes.name: recent_viral_infection
nodes.question_text: Have you recently had a viral infection, cold, flu, or respiratory illness?

nodes.name: prior_heart_attack_angina
nodes.question_text: Have you ever had a previous heart attack or diagnosed angina (coronary artery disease)?

nodes.name: smoker
nodes.question_text: Do you currently smoke cigarettes or have a history of smoking?

nodes.name: high_blood_pressure
nodes.question_text: Do you have high blood pressure (hypertension) or take blood pressure medications?

nodes.name: feeling_of_impending_doom
nodes.question_text: Do you feel an overwhelming fear or sensation that you are about to die (impending doom)?
